notes.title: 🌐 Public site restored (service reliability)
notes.body: Resolved a 404 on the root page and guest auth. Root cause: /api/auth/guest is a POST route that was being hit with GET; corrected the request method. All critical endpoints (/, /api/files, /api/tool, /api/auth/guest) now return 200 and the live service at neuralai-web-ui-deandrewharris.zocomputer.io is confirmed up.

notes.title: 🔌 Developer / API Access (BYO API)
notes.body: Generate a personal API key from Settings to use NeuralAI as an OpenAI-compatible backend on other hosts (e.g. ZO Computer's 'Bring Your Own Key'). Exposes /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models; keys are hashed and revocable.

notes.title: 📋 Auto Release Notes (What's New)
notes.body: A new 'What's New' panel surfaces the latest features and fixes automatically on update. Open it anytime from the top bar.

notes.title: 🖼️ Generated images now render in chat
notes.body: Image-generation responses are parsed as Markdown and displayed inline instead of raw text.

notes.title: 🤖 Model no longer talks to itself
notes.body: Chat now uses the ChatML prompt template (apply_chat_template) matching the model's training format, eliminating self-repeating turns.

notes.title: 📁 Upload success no longer shows empty list
notes.body: NeuralDrive now correctly handles both raw-array and {files:[]} API responses after an upload.

notes.title: 🌙 Dark theme by default
notes.body: The UI restores your saved theme on load and defaults to dark mode, fixing white file-cards in light mode.

notes.title: 🚀 Phase 8: Knowledge Graph & Agentic Autonomy
notes.body: Advanced long-term memory for cross-project context ('Supermemory') and fully autonomous task execution are now in active development.

notes.title: 🎯 The NeuralLabs Shift
notes.body: NeuralAI is evolving into a standalone, downloadable intelligence environment (NeuralLabs v1 Client, v2 Edge, v3 Eco).
